content.title: Barry Bonds Added to MLB Opening Night Talent Roster
content.text: Barry Bonds Added to MLB Opening Night Talent RosterBaseball’s home run king and leader joins the desk as Giants vs. Yankees opens a new era of MLB on March 25.A baseball legend has officially entered the batter’s box for Netflix.San Francisco Giants great Barry Bonds joins the star-studded roster of on-air talent for Netflix’s Major League Baseball broadcasts this season. The league’s home run king and leader will make his debut as an analyst on March 25, when his former club hosts the New York Yankees for MLB Opening Night, presented by Adobe.A seven-time Most Valuable Player, Bonds will take part in all three of Netflix’s MLB broadcasts this year: Opening Night, the T-Mobile Home Run Derby on July 13, and MLB at Field of Dreams on Aug. 13, all live exclusively on Netflix. Bonds will team up with two-time World Series champion and three-time MVP Albert Pujols, World Series champion Anthony Rizzo, and Emmy Award–winning host Elle Duncan at the pre- and postgame desk.FeaturedEverything that went down on Opening Night..By Michael EhrlichMarch 26NewsOn-air talent includes Hall of Famers, World Series champions, and the Home Run King.By Michael EhrlichMarch 25NewsPress play, play ball.By Christopher HudspethNov. 19Bonds holds MLB records for career home runs (762) and single-season home runs (73) while compiling 14 All-Star Game appearances, 12 Silver Slugger awards, and eight Gold Gloves awards, among other accolades.When is MLB Opening Night on Netflix?Date: Wednesday, March 25, 2026Time: 5:00 p.m. PT / 8:00 p.m. ETPregame show: 4:00 p.m. PT / 7:00 p.m. ETLocation: Oracle Park, San FranciscoHow to watch Yankees vs. Giants:To watch Major League Baseball Opening Night, you’ll just need an active Netflix subscription — the games are included in all plans. Once you’re signed in on any supported device, simply open Netflix and select the MLB Opening Night stream to start watching.Set a reminder for Major League Baseball Opening Night here.Who else is calling Yankees vs. Giants?Netflix has set an all-star lineup of commentators, analysts, and special guests — in English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, and Portuguese — for MLB Opening Night.
